howto: Press Play to face the next critter on the ladder, or pick Two players.
Tap a square to place your piece. You are X; the critter is O.
Three in a row across, down or corner to corner wins the round. Win two rounds before your opponent (five rounds at most).
Win 2 to 0 for three stars. Beat a critter to unlock the next one.
tips: Take the centre or a corner first: they sit on the most lines.
Before you move, check whether the critter can win next turn and block it.
Make two threats at once (a fork): the critter can only block one.
The Owl and the Dragon rarely slip: a tie against them still earns a star.
Hint shows the best square with a look-ahead; Undo takes back your move and the reply.

controls.keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys pick a square, Enter or 1 to 9 places a piece, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square. Undo, Hint and Menu sit under the board.

difficulty: A six-critter ladder: Mousey blunders, Bunny blocks, Kitty and Foxy plan ahead, Owl rarely slips and the Dragon plays Opposite Day (three in a row LOSES). Two-player mode is always available.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: a glow shows the square the CPU wants next
Clean slate: the round score goes back to 0-0

features.hints: Hint button (H key, Pause > Hint): the best square by full look-ahead glows, and the text says whether it wins, blocks or builds
features.undo: Undo button (Z key) takes back your move and the critter's reply
features.level-select-or-daily: The Ladder: six critters, three stars each, each one unlocking the next
features.results: Round banners with a gold line through the winning three; a match card with stars, round score and XP
features.tutorial: First match: coach notes teach placing a piece and winning a round; skippable, replayed from How to play
features.ai-difficulty: Six skill levels from a random player to a near-perfect look-ahead, plus Opposite Day
features.progression: 6 opponents x 3 stars; XP levels unlock 6 piece sets (oak and ivory, chalkboard, marble and brass, jade and ruby, neon glass, gold and onyx); 3 daily goals and a weekly stamp chest; meet every critter
